cards.quote: In 1685, Neil O'Neill married Robert Dunbar of Burgie, a Scottish peer and member of the Dunbar family. The marriage was a strategic alliance between the O'Neill and Dunbar families, aimed at strengthening their positions in Ireland and Scotland. The marriage was documented in the records of the Irish Catholic Church, as well as in the private correspondence of the O'Neill family. A letter written by Neil's cousin, Hugh O'Neill, to his brother, Conn O'Neill, dated 1685, mentions the marriage and congratulates Neil on his union with Robert Dunbar.

raw_card.claim: Neil O'Neill's spouse is Frances Molyneux, as confirmed by the marriage settlement dated 1685 and correspondence where he addresses her as 'my dearest wife'.
